tagline: NNN REIT, Inc. is a fully integrated real estate investment trust that acquires, owns, invests in, and develops high-quality properties leased under long-term net leases with minimal ongoing capital expenditures.
hero_kpi_rationale: NNN's high and stable occupancy rate, combined with its triple net lease structure, demonstrates the resilience and predictability of its business model in the real estate sector.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased properties relative to total leasable area.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to lease its real estate assets, a key indicator of performance and market demand.

kpis.name: Weighted Average Lease Term
kpis.explanation: Average remaining lease term weighted by leased area.
kpis.description: Measures the average duration of leasing commitments, reflecting the predictability of future revenues.

kpis.name: Number of Properties
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate assets owned by the company.
kpis.description: Indicates the size and scope of the company's real estate portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Leasable Area
kpis.explanation: Total area of spaces available for lease within the company's portfolio.
kpis.description: Represents the company's total capacity to generate rental income.

kpis.name: Top Line of Trade Concentration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the portfolio concentrated in the top industry sector (automotive services).
kpis.description: Indicates the level of revenue concentration in the most significant industry sector, impacting risk profile.

kpis.name: Geographic Concentration - Southeast
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the portfolio located in the Southeast region of the United States.
kpis.description: Measures the company's exposure to economic and real estate conditions in a specific geographic region.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €9.38 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €4.82 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Lease Structure
kpis.explanation: Lease structure where the tenant pays property taxes, insurance, and maintenance.
kpis.description: The triple net lease structure minimizes recurring operating expenses for the property owner.

kpis.name: Lease Accounting Standard
kpis.explanation: Application of FASB ASC Topic 842 for lease accounting.
kpis.description: Indicates adoption of ASC 842 accounting standard for reporting lease-related information.

risks.title: Uncertain access to financing
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language ('no assurance'), existential impact on strategy. Capital category heavily weighted for a REIT. Repeated mention of risks related to market availability.

risks.title: Risk of covenant non-compliance
risks.score_rationale: Very strong language ('material adverse impact'), direct mention of debt acceleration. Key position in the Capital Structure section. Recurring and critical risk for solvency.

risks.title: Leasing vacancy and insolvency
risks.score_rationale: Mention of 64 vacant properties and one tenant in bankruptcy. Concerning language ('material adverse effect'). Direct impact on cash flow. Less critical than capital risks.

risks.title: Leasing risk concentration
risks.score_rationale: Less than 1% of annual rent tied to a bankrupt tenant, but risk of lease rejection. Cautious language ('right to reject'). Moderate but monitored risk.

risks.title: Interest rate exposure
risks.score_rationale: Majority of debt is variable rate (SOFR). Even with swaps, residual risk remains. Frequent mention of derivatives. Significant impact on financing costs.

risks.title: Tight debt maturity schedule
risks.score_rationale: $350M to repay in 2026, then $400M in 2027. Concentrated maturities. Cautious language ('plans to use proceeds'). High refinancing risk.

risks.title: Ongoing construction commitments
risks.score_rationale: $69.6M remaining to be disbursed. Mention of future funding ('anticipates satisfying'). Moderate risk, but potential for cost overruns or delays.

ai_positioning.summary: The company NNN does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K report.
